result:
Post revisions are implemented: `bun run typecheck` passes and `bun test` passes (10 tests, 8 of them new); lint and `guren check --docs` are clean too.

One behaviour to know about: a save that changes nothing still keeps a revision. The request left this open, and I chose the rule with no exceptions, so restoring identical content behaves the same way as any other edit.

## Summary

I added a `post_revisions` table (`db/schema.ts` plus the generated migration `db/migrations/20260929174727_create_post_revisions/`) and a `PostRevision` model in `app/Models/PostRevision.ts`. Its `replaceContent()` helper copies the post's current title, excerpt and body into a revision and then writes the new content. `PostController.update` and the new restore action both call it inside one transaction, so a refused or failed edit keeps nothing; I confirmed the rollback with a throwaway script. The new `app/Http/Controllers/PostRevisionController.ts` serves `GET /posts/:id/revisions` (page `posts/Revisions`, props `post` and `revisions` newest first) and `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` (redirects to `/posts/:id`). Both routes are registered in the `auth` group in `routes/web.ts`, so guests go to `/login`. Non-authors get 403 through a new `manageRevisions` ability in `app/Policies/PostPolicy.ts`, and a revision belonging to another post answers 404 because it is looked up by id and post id together. `PostController.destroy` now deletes the post's revisions and the post in one transaction, because SQLite foreign keys are off on this app's connection (`PRAGMA foreign_keys` is 0) and the `ON DELETE CASCADE` on the foreign key would not fire. Supporting pieces are `PostRevisionResource`, `PostRevisionParamSchema` in `PostValidator.ts`, the page `resources/js/pages/posts/Revisions.tsx`, a "Revisions" link for the author in `posts/Show.tsx`, and the regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` files. Feature tests are in `tests/PostRevisions.test.ts`, and the decisions are recorded in `docs/adr/0002-keep-post-revisions-on-every-edit.md`.
